quiz_item.question: When planning a major family purchase under Requirement 1, why should you compare total cost of ownership and financing options across multiple retailers rather than looking only at the monthly payment?
options: A. Because a lower monthly payment always guarantees a lower total purchase price and zero interest charges.
B. Because long-term financing with high interest rates, fees, maintenance, and operating costs can make a low monthly payment far more expensive overall than saving up to pay cash.
C. Because retail stores are legally required to match the lowest monthly payment offered by any online auction site.
D. Because comparison shopping only applies to consumable groceries and does not affect durable goods or warranties.
choices: A. Because a lower monthly payment always guarantees a lower total purchase price and zero interest charges.
B. Because long-term financing with high interest rates, fees, maintenance, and operating costs can make a low monthly payment far more expensive overall than saving up to pay cash.
C. Because retail stores are legally required to match the lowest monthly payment offered by any online auction site.
D. Because comparison shopping only applies to consumable groceries and does not affect durable goods or warranties.
quiz_item.correct_answer: B. Because long-term financing with high interest rates, fees, maintenance, and operating costs can make a low monthly payment far more expensive overall than saving up to pay cash.
quiz_item.explanation: Correct Answer (B): Evaluating needs versus wants, comparison shopping for quality and price, and calculating interest, warranties, and operating expenses reveals the true total cost of a major purchase.

requirements.req_text: Do the following: (a) Prepare a budget reflecting your expected income (allowance, gifts, wages), expenses, and savings for a period of 13 consecutive weeks. (b) Compare expected income with expected expenses. (1) If expenses exceed budget income, determine steps to balance your budget. (2) If income exceeds budget expenses, state how you would use the excess money (new goal, savings). (c) Track and record your actual income, expenses, and savings for 13 consecutive weeks (the same 13-week period for which you budgeted). (You may use the forms provided in the Personal Management merit badge pamphlet, devise your own, or use a computer-generated version.) When complete, present the records showing the results to your counselor. (d) Compare your budget with your actual income and expenses to understand when your budget worked and when it did not work. With your counselor, discuss what you might do differently the next time.

patrol_quiz_bank.question: When planning a major family purchase under Requirement 1, why should you compare total cost of ownership and financing options across multiple retailers rather than looking only at the monthly payment?
options: A. Because a lower monthly payment always guarantees a lower total purchase price and zero interest charges.
B. Because long-term financing with high interest rates, fees, maintenance, and operating costs can make a low monthly payment far more expensive overall than saving up to pay cash.
C. Because retail stores are legally required to match the lowest monthly payment offered by any online auction site.
D. Because comparison shopping only applies to consumable groceries and does not affect durable goods or warranties.
choices: A. Because a lower monthly payment always guarantees a lower total purchase price and zero interest charges.
B. Because long-term financing with high interest rates, fees, maintenance, and operating costs can make a low monthly payment far more expensive overall than saving up to pay cash.
C. Because retail stores are legally required to match the lowest monthly payment offered by any online auction site.
D. Because comparison shopping only applies to consumable groceries and does not affect durable goods or warranties.
patrol_quiz_bank.correct_answer: B. Because long-term financing with high interest rates, fees, maintenance, and operating costs can make a low monthly payment far more expensive overall than saving up to pay cash.
patrol_quiz_bank.explanation: Correct Answer (B): Evaluating needs versus wants, comparison shopping for quality and price, and calculating interest, warranties, and operating expenses reveals the true total cost of a major purchase.

patrol_quiz_bank.correct_answer: B. Cut nonessential expenses, find ways to increase income, or choose a less expensive goal
patrol_quiz_bank.explanation: Correct Answer (B): To balance a budget when expenses exceed income, you should identify expenses you can give up, adopt cost-saving measures, take more time to reach your goal, or choose a less expensive option (p. 22).

D. It spreads money across many different investments so poor performance in one does not ruin the whole portfolio
choices: A. It guarantees that individual stock prices will never go down on any trading day
B. It converts all high-risk stocks into federally insured bank savings accounts automatically

patrol_quiz_bank.correct_answer: D. It spreads money across many different investments so poor performance in one does not ruin the whole portfolio
patrol_quiz_bank.explanation: Correct Answer (D): Diversification means owning many different investments instead of just one or a few, which reduces overall portfolio risk (p. 29).
